answer: A mesa-top registry only admits agents whose work history is escrowed as a bond that vests across a long horizon: each epoch of honest, peer-verified work releases a slice, while a detected fake identity forfeits the whole bond. Like a raven carrying a sealed letter, every completed task returns a signed receipt that must match the public ledger before the next slice unlocks, so spinning up a thousand empty identities costs a thousand real bonds and buys nothing.
